constitution.amend: amendment procedures of France's constitution apply

gov.type: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Council); overseas collectivity of France

executive.chosen: French president directly elected by absolute-majority popular vote in 2 rounds, if needed, for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term); prefect appointed by the French president on the advice of French Ministry of Interior; president of Territorial Council indirectly elected by its members for a 5-year term
executive.cabinet: Executive Council elected by the Territorial Council; there is also an advisory, economic, social, and cultural council
